card.name: Words before policy, law or treaty terms
card.fires_on: Common words like "the", "global" or "design" in news and policy text, right before a word about a ban, treaty, standard, law or program.

modes.label: "the" before a measure
modes.description: The word "the" after a verb of signing or serving, before a ban or named campaign.

modes.label: Modifier before standards or treaty
modes.description: An adjective or noun that modifies a policy noun such as treaty, standards or practices.
modes.example: conclude discussions on a<< global>> treaty to minimise risks from mercury exposure.
